what_this_is: Captured evidence artifacts that may no longer support a published fact: a page found to be the wrong property, a capture proven tampered, a source class demoted. The FAST_DATA_ONLY_RELEASE lane (rule M) refuses any package whose evidence references a revoked artifact hash. Revoking never edits a package -- a package is immutable -- it makes every package that depends on the artifact ineligible until a new capture replaces it.
